title: MotionSetup
description: Output of the Motion Director for a single shot: subject motion and its timing, independent of camera movement (see camera.schema.json, which owns camera motion).

motion_strength.description: Normalized 0-100 value. Render Configuration Compiler rescales this to the active engine's motion_strength_range from its CapabilityManifest.

easing_curve.description: Animation curve for subject motion over the shot's duration. Kept consistent with this shot's camera.movement.easing by default, but is a distinct value - a shot can have a linear camera dolly with an ease-in-out subject movement, or vice versa.

speed_ramp.description: Optional list of {t, speed_multiplier} keyframes for slow-motion / speed-ramp effects.
